about_the_game:
Feeding My Ducks is a cozy idle-management game designed to sit alongside your day, offering moments of relaxation, lighthearted fun, and surprising discovery. At its core, it’s about raising a flock of ducks—feeding them, training them, and guiding them through quirky mini-games—while watching them evolve into unique, unexpected forms.

The game is built to complement your lifestyle: it can run quietly in the background while you work or study, giving you an ever-present companion of cheerful ducks waiting for your care. Whether you spend minutes or hours, you’ll always return to new antics, progress, and charm.

🌿 Key Features 🌿

  • Raise & Nurture: Feed your ducks with bread, seeds, and playful treats to keep them happy and healthy.

  • Train & Grow: Build up your ducks’ five key stats—Power, Intelligence, Speed, Vitality, and Charm—through a variety of fun mini-games.

  • Engaging Mini-Games: Test your ducks in lighthearted competitions like log-chopping races, hurdle runs, and even sparring matches of 1-on-1 tournament-style Quack-Fu.

  • Evolve & Discover: Watch as your ducks transform into whimsical evolutions, each with its own personality and flair.

  • A Cozy Companion: Designed to fit into your day, the game rests neatly at the bottom of your screen, giving you a productivity-friendly companion without demanding your full attention.

🌟 Why You’ll Love It 🌟

Feeding My Ducks is more than a game—it’s a digital companion. Its charm lies in the balance between simplicity and depth: an easy, cozy atmosphere where you can relax, paired with layers of progression, achievements, and discovery that reward your care.

It’s not about high stakes or fast reflexes. It’s about delight in the small things: feeding, watching, evolving, and enjoying the quirky company of your ducks as they cheer you on through your day.

✨ Simple. Charming. Endlessly ducky. ✨

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10
  • Processor: 1.2GHz
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 8-compatible graphics card with at least 32MB of video memory
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10
  • Processor: 1.2GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 8-compatible graphics card with at least 32MB of video memory
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
